Reverse Image Search on Google: Why Website Owners Should Care

Images are valuable digital assets, but many website owners overlook how easily they can be copied, misused, or duplicated across the internet. With tools like reverse image search Google, anyone can upload or paste an image and instantly find where it appears online.
